WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
avg_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(order_count) as avg_order_count
  FROM order_counts
),
differences AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    oc.order_count,
    oc.order_count - ao.avg_order_count as difference
  FROM order_counts oc
  JOIN account a ON oc.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  CROSS JOIN avg_orders ao
)
SELECT 
  account_id,
  region,
  order_count,
  difference
FROM differences
WHERE difference >= (
  SELECT MIN(difference)
  FROM (
    SELECT difference FROM differences ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
  ) AS top_ten
)
ORDER BY difference DESC;
